archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with a Tech Edge
design_philosophy: A high-end, futuristic dark-mode dashboard inspired by aethersy.com. Emphasizes clean aesthetics, deep blacks, subtle glassmorphism, precise grids, and sharp electric cyan accents. Avoids standard 'AI slop' colors like purple/violet and generic fonts like Inter/Roboto.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Protocol: Tight bento grid layouts (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), ensuring full height utilization using h-full. Widgets align perfectly without jagged edges.

surfaces_and_textures.cards: Flat background (#0D0D0D) with 1px solid border (white/8). On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle inner glow or border glow (cyan/30).
surfaces_and_textures.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a delicate 1px bottom border (white/10).
surfaces_and_textures.background_texture: Use a very subtle grid or noise overlay on the deepest background to avoid pure digital flatness.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#33F3FF] transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-white/10 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-surface_hover transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-text_secondary hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-black border border-white/10 text-white rounded-md px-3 py-2 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary transition-all
components.sidebar: Fixed w-64 h-screen border-r border-white/10 bg-[#050505] flex flex-col pt-6 pb-6
components.tables: Shadcn Table with text-sm, border-b border-white/5 on rows, text-text_secondary headers
components.badges: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-text_secondary

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: All interactive elements must explicitly change state on hover (e.g., text brightens to white, borders glow).
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-in up (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> 1) for dashboard grids.

global.layout: Sidebar on left (collapsible on mobile), Top Header (glassmorphic) with search, notifications, and user avatar. Main content area fills remaining space.

login_register.layout: Split screen or centered glass card over abstract background.
login_register.visuals: Use image `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1759338245039-906f7558e743?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NTYxODh8MHwxfHNlYXJjaHwyfHxkYXJrJTIwYWJzdHJhY3QlMjBtaW5pbWFsJTIwdGV4dHVyZXxlbnwwfHx8fDE3Nzc5OTg4MTh8MA&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=85` as full screen background with black overlay.

dashboard_home.layout: Top row: 4 KPI cards (Stats, % changes in Jade Green/Red). Middle: Main line chart spanning 3 cols, Activity feed spanning 1 col. Bottom: Data tables.

ai_web_research.layout: 2-column layout. Left: Query parameters, strict form fields. Right: Real-time streaming results area (markdown rendered text, skeleton loading state).

ai_business_plan.layout: Left inner-nav for sections (Exec Summary, Market Analysis, etc.). Right: WYSIWYG or Markdown editor view. Top right: Export to PDF/Docx buttons.

ai_smart_chat.layout: Left pane: Chat history threads. Main pane: Chat bubbles (User: bordered glass card, AI: seamless background). Input pinned at bottom with a glowing 'Send' button.

code_generator.layout: Split pane. Left: Prompt text area. Right: Monaco editor or syntax-highlighted block displaying generated code with copy button and language selector.

crm_lead_management.layout: Kanban board view (horizontal scrolling columns) for lead stages. Clicking a card opens a shadcn Sheet (drawer) from the right with lead details.

finance_crypto_tracker.layout: Top: Horizontal scrolling list of crypto price cards with mini sparkline charts. Below: Large interactive candlestick or area chart with volume data.

email_marketing_ai.layout: Timeline view of email sequences. Right pane showing template preview. Status indicators (Sent, Draft, Scheduled).

funnel_builder.layout: Full canvas feel. Use `bg-[radial-gradient(#ffffff22_1px,transparent_1px)]` for a dotted background. Nodes represent funnel steps connected by lines.

telegram_bot.layout: Status overview card (Active/Offline) at top. Below: split view with Bot configuration form and a terminal-styled window showing live message logs.

backgrounds.description: Dark metallic curved surface, use for login background
Abstract dark textured surface, use as subtle overlay pattern

testing.required_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard'`).
